title: Roast Turkey Breast with Root Vegetables
description: A simply seasoned roast turkey breast with caramelized carrots, parsnips and onions.
steps: Toss the vegetables with oil and seasoning around the turkey breast in a roasting tin.
Roast at 190C for about 50-60 minutes until the turkey is cooked through.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing and serving with the vegetables.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food poultry collection

notes: A great Sunday batch-cook — slice and portion the leftovers for lunches through the week.
